# p10k-rs v0.2.6

**The "actually ship the Windows artifacts" release.** v0.2.5 built
Windows binaries cleanly but the workflow's release-notes-locator step
is `bash` syntax and Windows runners default to PowerShell. Both
`windows-msvc` jobs failed at that step *after* build / package /
sign / attest all succeeded. v0.2.5's release page therefore carries
only the four unix artifact triples; v0.2.6 reships everything with
the one-line fix.

## What changed

### Fixed

- `.github/workflows/release.yml`'s "locate release notes" step forces
  `shell: bash`. Git Bash already ships on `windows-latest` — same
  routing the sigstore-sign step uses.

### Added

- `.github/workflows/perf.yml` — closes the orphan
  `bench/compare_criterion.sh` from the v0.2.x cycle. PR perf-regression
  gate against `crates/p10k-rs-git` criterion benches; markdown table
  posted as a sticky PR comment.

## What you'll see (if the pipeline behaves)

The release page should carry **18 assets**:

- `p10k-rs-0.2.6-{x86_64,aarch64}-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz{,.sha256,.cosign.bundle}` (6 unix linux)
- `p10k-rs-0.2.6-{x86_64,aarch64}-apple-darwin.tar.gz{,.sha256,.cosign.bundle}` (6 unix macOS)
- `p10k-rs-0.2.6-{x86_64,aarch64}-pc-windows-msvc.zip{,.sha256,.cosign.bundle}` (6 windows)

vs v0.2.5's 12 (unix only).

## Verification

Windows users:

```pwsh
.\install.ps1                  # one-liner install
Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 p10k-rs-0.2.6-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip
gh attestation verify p10k-rs-0.2.6-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip `
   --repo scurran1986/powerlevel10k-rs
```

Unix users — unchanged from v0.2.5.

## What's the same

Everything else. No code touched. Schema, themes, segments, all five
Linux gates, both Windows `cargo check` targets — all green.
